description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Head of PDP-Connect/data-connect main as of 2026-09-02 (merge of data-connect#41, 'fix(polyfill-connectors): sync claude_code/codex/google_messages from canonical' — re-vendors the three connectors that had drifted from this repo's canonical copies, plus the local-jsonl-cursor/fingerprint-cursor runtime primitives those connectors now depend on). Supersedes the prior 63a3792 pin (2026-09-02, this same day): pin-freshness — data-connect had gone red on packages/polyfill-connectors/connectors/{claude_code,codex,google_messages} (this repo's own connector-source drift check agreed — see check-connector-source-drift.mjs's job). This repo's own vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz and vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz were re-packed from this SHA in the same change that moved this pin: the prior pin (63a3792) was itself already one commit behind an UNRELATED dependabot npm bump (#37, adef32f) that data-connect#41 was based on top of, and that bump touches packages/collector-runtime/package.json and packages/connector-protocol/package.json (devDependency/dependency version bumps only, e.g. zod ^4.4.3→^4.5.2) — confirmed via a fresh repack that this changes the packed package.json bytes, so this re-vendor was required regardless of the connector-source fix. See packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/SHA256SUMS for the new digests. Source of truth for drift jobs (a) collector-definitions snapshot, (b) vendored connector sources, and the 0.0.1 half of (c) tarball digests.

data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from data-connect PR #36's tree — this is PR #36's merge commit into main ('Add local collection and release checks', merged 2026-09-02T07:53:00Z), superseding the prior 10f25a3cd6 pin which recorded the PR's pre-merge head commit. Confirmed via `git diff 10f25a3cd6..b70dda89a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts` (empty — the merge is a true two-parent merge of the reviewed branch, not a squash, so the packages this pin backs are byte-identical between the two commits; the merge additionally picked up an unrelated repo-wide SPDX-header sweep and other main-tip drift, none of it touching these paths) that the previously-vendored 1.0.0 tarballs still reconcile: no re-vendor needed, this is a SHA-reference-only update. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the `data-connect` pin above and this one (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp PR #284's branch (waspflow/move-b-step7-remove-reference-implementation-0902) as of 2026-09-02, NOT yet merged to main — deliberately tracks the open PR's head branch during this coordinated cutover window, per this file's own pattern (see data-connect-1-0-0's note on why a pin can track a PR-head branch rather than main). Supersedes the prior f1e8357d0 pin (pdpp#281 catch-up). pdpp#284 deletes reference-implementation/, apps/console, packages/cli, packages/mcp-server, and packages/read-core entirely — that code's canonical home is now PDP-Connect/data-connect (data-connect#42/#43/#44). This move requires two coordinated changes in THIS repo, both in the same PR as this pin move: (1) check-reference-contract-drift.mjs no longer compares packages/polyfill-connectors/src/reference-implementation-stand-in/ against pdpp — that stand-in's canonical source (reference-implementation/runtime/recovery-reason-codes.ts) no longer exists at any pdpp SHA, so it is now a permanent local copy, not a pinned mirror (see that directory's own README, 'Removal trigger — FIRED'); (2) cross-repo-integrity.yml's `integration` job, which cloned pdpp at the pinned SHA and ran connectors/github/index.test.ts + bin/orchestrate.ts against pdpp's real reference-implementation server, is retired — its premise (a pdpp checkout containing that server) is gone, and data-connect is not a drop-in substitute checkout (different repo layout: no packages/reference-contract, no packages/read-core, npm not pnpm workspaces — confirmed by inspection, not attempted as a same-PR fix). The vendor tarball half of drift job (d) (packages/reference-contract/src/common/terminal-run-commit.ts, evidence/coherence.ts, evidence/collection-scope.ts) is UNCHANGED — packages/reference-contract stays in pdpp (pdpp#284, decision D-22) and apps/site still depends on packages/display, packages/pdpp-brand(-react), packages/operator-ui, and packages/list-envelope, none of which moved. Verified byte-identical via `git diff f1e8357d0..d2512e22c -- packages/reference-contract/src/common/terminal-run-commit.ts packages/reference-contract/src/evidence/coherence.ts packages/reference-contract/src/evidence/collection-scope.ts` (empty). Once pdpp#284 merges to main, this pin's `branch` field should drop back to `main` in a routine follow-up repin — not done here, since the PR is not yet merged.
